create.name: Task name
create.description: Leave the branch blank to generate a unique pi-agent/* branch. A custom branch must be a new, valid Git branch; existing branches are never overwritten or deleted.

empty.notGit: This folder is not a usable Git repository
empty.localFallback: Only Local mode is available; the app will not pretend this task is isolated.
empty.noWorktrees: This repository has no managed worktrees yet.

remove.title: Remove this worktree?
remove.description: Safety checks passed. The branch is kept unless you explicitly choose to delete it.
remove.forceTitle: This worktree cannot be removed safely
remove.forceDescription: Uncommitted, unmerged, unpushed, or inconsistent state was found. Normal removal is blocked.
remove.prohibitedDescription: Switch to another project and stop tasks running in this worktree before removing it. An active worktree cannot be force-deleted.
remove.confirmRisk: I confirm forced removal and understand that uncommitted files or unintegrated commits may be permanently lost.

blockers.not-registered: The path is absent from Git's worktree list
blockers.unmerged: Commits have not been merged into the base
blockers.active-workspace: The current UI or a background task is using this worktree

unregistered.title: {{count}} unregistered worktree found
unregistered.description: They may have been created by Git or another tool. The app reports them without adopting or deleting them.
